title: Audit staged544 native phases and expose the binary-inverse lift defect
body:
PR3945 changes 26 terminal frames per staged544 provider. A binary frame/owner audit cannot establish the signed native action. This independently checks every promoted cold residual and all five genuinely changed warp interfaces per provider, including both warp directions and old/new interfaces: **40 unique interfaces, 144 source occurrences, 20,480 complete basis-column equalities**. All pass. Another 47 warp-record changes per provider only shift chronological indices.

The pairing of framed arithmetic with finite symplectic geometry gives a useful source-bound warning: for the actual map `G=[1,2,8,32,44,128,59,66,489]`, the canonical lift of the binary inverse satisfies `K_(G inverse) K_G = Z_256`, changing the signs of 256 basis coordinates despite an identity binary map. The author's correct adjoint passes; this is a phase-discipline witness, **not an author bug**. The correction is a nonconstant Pauli character, not just global phase.

The new standard-library verifier uses exact Gaussian integers and independent serialized-recipe decoding; it executes no predecessor compiler/checker. Frozen predecessor code is used only for optional reference generation. Fourteen phase, rank, basis and coverage mutations reject. Actual dirty-state coverage is equality on all 512 basis columns at each local interface, with every output coefficient and global phase checked. Whole-program dirty cleanup, changed scalar-transition classes and supplier admission are separate.

Frozen release crosslinks are also checked from included raw bytes: both actual word hashes, native recipe inventories, final package manifest and reported release receipt. The full native recipe payload and release execution are not replayed. The author's disclosed frozen-spec corrections and reused successful prefixes remain explicit. The complete ledger distinguishes proved local ranks, inherited owner costs, and unknown physical/uniform/outer obligations. No selected κ change.

Validation at scientific commit `fc536202fdaa924158789a5ef59ac079bbe21922`:

- Registered normal and optimized Python replay: PASS, 16.143 s and 15.333 s.
- Exact committed-byte/source-history check and 34-file archive integrity check: PASS.
- Read-only Git-free isolated optimized verifier: PASS, 22.033 s; checked files unchanged.
- Optional pinned-compiler regeneration: byte-identical recipes; independent verification is separate.
- Hosted CI **passed** at the exact scientific commit: [Registered research packages, run39220080489](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39220080489).

See `research/staged544-native-quadratic-audit/README.md`, `PROOF.md`, `RESULT.json`, `LEDGER.json` and `VALIDATION.json`. Source is PR3945 at `91f81d131252db704f945891da1ea54e29d46b8b`; complements PR3969 at `6ff67539f1131a287eb9a9a98bf1e94a02eecba7`. Canonical main remained `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. Prepublication overlap used 685 open PR bodies with partial live Discussion coverage; no exhaustive novelty claim.

Credit: Dugongue (PR3945/3929), dataisfire (PR3734), Cinna Davis (PR2226), Tekalign, icekylinx, DreamingOfClouds, Sagar Thakrar, roger-sato, Arham Tahir and the full retained native/owner lineage. Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; root-agent coordination supplied a separately authenticated release-link inspection that this verifier rechecks. Apache-2.0. No merge/closure or frontier change requested.
